media.title: Hans Steinhoff — portrait photograph
media.description: Hans Steinhoff, German film director, shown reading a book; the photograph dates from the occupation years, 1939–1945.
media.altText: Black-and-white photograph of Hans Steinhoff reading a book and gesturing, with another man partly visible at right.
media.rightsNote: Public domain. The photograph belongs to the Wydawnictwo Prasowe Kraków-Warszawa fond at Narodowe Archiwum Cyfrowe, the photographic archive of the German-run press publisher in occupied Poland, under ref. 3/2/0/-/14347 (former 2-14347); the archive dates it 1939–1945 and records it as domena publiczna, permitting reproduction, adaptation and distribution, including commercial use, without permission. No photographer is named and the first publication is not established. Both readings the fond admits reach the public domain before 1 January 1996, so the URAA restored nothing: a photograph published in Poland without a reservation of copyright never entered protection there, and a German press photograph of those years ran a fifty-year term from publication that expired by 1995. The reading that would not — an artistic photographic work rather than routine press photography — is not one the archive record supports.
media.publicCaption: Hans Steinhoff, who directed Madame wünscht keine Kinder (1933) and its French version, both with songs by Kaper and Jurmann.
